items.stem: Which of the following best describes "estimated mean"?
options: The running total of frequencies up to the upper boundary of each class
The values that split ordered data into four equal parts: Q1 (25%), median (50%), Q3 (75%)
The difference between the largest and smallest values
The mean of grouped data found using the midpoint of each class: Σ(f × midpoint) ÷ Σf

items.stem: A data set has range 63 but IQR 11. Explain what this suggests about the data.

items.stem: For the grouped data 100 ≤ x < 105: 5; 105 ≤ x < 110: 2; 110 ≤ x < 115: 2; 115 ≤ x < 120: 13, explain why the estimated mean could be higher or lower than the true mean.
items.answer: Values in a class may cluster above or below the midpoint.

items.stem: Briefly explain why a box plot is useful for comparing two distributions.
